originalTitle: Arch Capital Group (ACGL) Outpaces Stock Market Gains: What You Should Know
summary: Arch Capital Group (ACGL) reached $99.83 at the closing of the latest trading day, reflecting a +1.65% change compared to its last close.
content:
In the latest close session, Arch Capital Group (ACGL) was up +1.65% at $99.83. The stock outpaced the S&P 500's daily gain of 1.06%. Elsewhere, the Dow gained 1.18%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq added 1.4%.

Coming into today, shares of the property and casualty insurer had lost 0.89% in the past month. In that same time, the Finance sector gained 0.85%, while the S&P 500 gained 2.46%.

Market participants will be closely following the financial results of Arch Capital Group in its upcoming release. The company's upcoming EPS is projected at $1.88, signifying a 32.13% drop compared to the same quarter of the previous year. In the meantime, our current consensus estimate forecasts the revenue to be $4.46 billion, indicating a 5.4% decline compared to the corresponding quarter of the prior year.

For the full year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates project earnings of $9.44 per share and a revenue of $17.7 billion, demonstrating changes of -4.07% and -5.81%, respectively, from the preceding year.

Additionally, investors should keep an eye on any recent revisions to analyst forecasts for Arch Capital Group. Recent revisions tend to reflect the latest near-term business trends. Therefore, positive revisions in estimates convey analysts' confidence in the business performance and profit potential.

Our research reveals that these estimate alterations are directly linked with the stock price performance in the near future. To take advantage of this, we've established the Zacks Rank, an exclusive model that considers these estimated changes and delivers an operational rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, running from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), holds an admirable track record of superior performance, independently audited, with #1 stocks contributing an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Within the past 30 days, our consensus EPS projection has moved 0.44% higher. At present, Arch Capital Group boasts a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

In terms of valuation, Arch Capital Group is presently being traded at a Forward P/E ratio of 10.4. Its industry sports an average Forward P/E of 11.55, so one might conclude that Arch Capital Group is trading at a discount comparatively.

We can also see that ACGL currently has a PEG ratio of 4.84. This popular metric is similar to the widely-known P/E ratio, with the difference being that the PEG ratio also takes into account the company's expected earnings growth rate. As of the close of trade yesterday, the Insurance - Property and Casualty industry held an average PEG ratio of 1.71.

The Insurance - Property and Casualty industry is part of the Finance sector. This group has a Zacks Industry Rank of 60, putting it in the top 25% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank assesses the vigor of our specific industry groups by computing the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks incorporated in the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: Arch Capital Group (ACGL) 的涨幅超过股市：您应该知道什么
chineseSummary: Arch Capital Group (ACGL)在最近一个交易日收盘时达到99.83美元，较上一交易日收盘价上涨+1.65%。
chineseContent:
在最近的收盘交易中，Arch Capital Group (ACGL) 上涨 1.65%，至 99.83 美元。该股的日涨幅超过标准普尔 500 指数 1.06%。其他方面，道指上涨 1.18%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 1.4%。

截至今天，该财产和意外伤害保险公司的股价在过去一个月下跌了 0.89%。与此同时，金融板块上涨 0.85%，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 2.46%。

市场参与者将密切关注Arch Capital Group即将发布的财务业绩。该公司即将公布的每股收益预计为1.88美元，较去年同期下降32.13%。与此同时，我们目前的共识预测收入为 44.6 亿美元，比去年同期下降 5.4%。

Zacks 一致估计全年每股收益为 9.44 美元，营收为 177 亿美元，较上年分别变化-4.07% 和 -5.81%。

此外，投资者应关注近期对 Arch Capital Group 分析师预测的修订。最近的修订往往反映最新的近期业务趋势。因此，预测的积极修正传达了分析师对业务业绩和利润潜力的信心。

我们的研究表明，这些估计的变化与近期的股价表现直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们建立了 Zacks Rank，这是一个独特的模型，考虑了这些估计的变化并提供了一个可操作的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有令人钦佩的卓越业绩记录，经过独立审计，自 1988 年以来，#1 股票贡献的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天内，我们的共识 EPS 预测上升了 0.44%。目前，Arch Capital Group 的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

就估值而言，Arch Capital Group 目前的远期市盈率为 10.4。该行业的平均远期市盈率为 11.55，因此人们可能会得出结论，Arch Capital Group 的交易价格相对较低。

我们还可以看到ACGL目前的PEG比率为4.84。这个流行的指标与广为人知的市盈率类似，不同之处在于，PEG比率还考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天收盘，保险-财产和意外伤害行业的平均 PEG 率为 1.71。

保险-财产和意外伤害行业是金融行业的一部分。该集团的 Zacks 行业排名为 60，在所有 250 多个行业中排名前 25%。

Zacks 行业排名通过计算特定行业组中个股的平均 Zacks 排名来评估我们特定行业组的活力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
